architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

design_decisions: SVC-015 is the only service involved in this single-capability journey. SmscrReview lifecycle is fully internal to CAP-005.
EVT-165 SmscrReviewCompleted is published primarily for the audit pipeline — it is the only cross-service communication in this journey.

consumed_events.name: SmscrReviewCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable quarterly SM&CR review completion record (FCA audit evidence)

cross_service_interaction_summary: SVC-015 (CAP-005) → EVT-165 → SVC-103 (CAP-008): Quarterly review completion audit record
